title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. In the masjid of my area, for the month of ramzan, there is an arrangement made for Iftaar. For this purpose , they collect chanda. My Question is that, I know many people of my area who have interest (sood) in their earnings, and they will also pay their chanda.And i also have doubt that many people donot earn their income in a halaal way (i.e they lie in their business , do real estate etc..) and they will also pay their chanda.Is it permissible to attend the iftaar in the masjid? 2940 views Q. I want to do fasting on every Friday as due to health problem I left some in Ramdan, can I miss the sahayri as I want to get up only for Fajar because there will be a lot of time from saharyi to Fajr. 2362 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 15997 Country: India Title: assalamualaikkum mufti sb. i just wat to know whether is it permissible to give intravenous injections,insulin,ivfluids,minorsurgeries to the fasting paients? Question: assalamualaikkum mufti sb. i just wat to know whether is it permissible to give intravenous injections,insulin,ivfluids,minorsurgeries to the fasting paients? Answer ID: 15997 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1479/1481=M=1430) It is allowable to give intravenous injection or glucose to a patient who is fasting, it will not invalidate his fast. By minor surgeries, if you mean surgery of acnes etc in hands or legs it will not harm the fast. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
